description: Systemic lupus erythematosus is a chronic autoimmune inflammatory disease that can affect skin and multiple internal organs.
symptoms: Joint pain, swelling, or morning stiffness
causes: Immune dysregulation with production of autoantibodies
Genetic susceptibility and environmental or hormonal factors contribute
risk_factors: Sun exposure can trigger or aggravate cutaneous disease
Smoking is associated with more prevalent or severe disease

appearance.general: Cutaneous manifestations may include malar facial erythema, photosensitive eruptions, scaly plaques, and other forms of cutaneous lupus.

warning_signs: New neurological symptoms, chest pain or breathing difficulty, significant kidney-related symptoms, or severe systemic illness require prompt medical evaluation.
